scope: Whole design grouping across existing local corpus. Pixel mask evidence is used with render path and silhouette.

groups.reason: Standard two-layer armor; narrow torso bottom and open head already represented. Banglum main mask differs from bronze only in the top row, but its helmet ornaments differ.

Same HEAD-only renderer using standard L2 for LEGS. Hallowed and Runite share the exact shell and visor cuts despite different attachments; Banglum and Metallurgium use alternative ornaments with the same slot boundary. No variant credit; compare existing winged helmet family before independent acceptance.

Explicit slot branches switch separate body_belt/body_buckle and body_crest/body_armor on the same body root. Electrum instead renders legs with no torso pieces; the distinction is supported locally but whole-corpus semantic independence and acceptance remain open. Coral variants are same family.
